| ![FO76 publicteam xpd.png](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/1/15/FO76_publicteam_xpd.png/30px-FO76_publicteam_xpd.png) | For the update named after the location, see Milepost Zero (update). | 

**Milepost Zero** is a location within the Skyline Valley region of Appalachia. It is currently being used by the Blue Ridge Caravan Company as a home base for Caravan operations.

Prior to the Blue Ridge Caravan Company setting up in side, Milepost Zero used to be an old exit tunnel. The sign out in front reads:

THE ZERO MILE POST

This Zero Mile Post acts as a waypoint on the road for cargo vehicles travelling between Ohio, Pennsylvania and North Carolina. This route was surveyed by Chief Grayson Wells prior to the initial establishment of several markers at key points along the main line.

Marley and a crew of Blue Ridge Caravan Company members came to Milepost Zero in an attempt to establish a base of operations. Their first attempted failed due to the storm created by Hugo Stolz, [1] but with a second chance from Joanna Mayfield and help from the Vault Dwellers from Vault 76 they were able to reestablish their network in Skyline Valley.

Before it’s closure in Update 25: Burning Springs, through a variety of recruitable vendors, the Vault Dweller can upgrade Milepost Zero by spending Supplies earned during Caravan runs. This includes a variety of cosmetic and gameplay upgrades as follows below.

Marley handles all the recruitment of additional vendors, and the upgrade of their inventories, both of which require giving her Supplies.

| Vendor | Specialty | Base Recruitment Cost | Tier 2 Upgrade Cost | Tier 3 Upgrade Cost | 
| Axel & Gyro | Decorator | 125 | 150 | 200 | 
| Ineke | Imported Goods Merchant | 150 | 250 | 500 | 
| Josie | Brahmin Taming | 100 | 200 | None [2] | 
| Theodore | Ammo Merchant | 150 | 250 | None [3] | 

Theodore's inventory is one of two Milepost Zero merchant who's supplies can be purchased for with Caps. He has a variety of ammunition for sale.

Josie can provide different feeds to the Pack Brahmin that give them a variety of different skill boosts. She can also be talked to in order to change the name of a Pack Brahmin.

By speaking with Axel, he and Gyro can decorate the interior of Milepost Zero to a handful of different themes.

Ineke's inventory is one of two Milepost Zero merchant who's supplies can be purchased for with bottlecaps. She has a variety of plans for sale that are exclusive to her.

Milepost Zero consists of two main sections, a ground floor and raised overlook upper level that overlooks bits of the lower level. None of the characters with the exception of Marley will be in Milepost Zero without unlocking them first.

Walking into the tunnel, the Vault Dweller is greeted by Marley on the left hand side, standing next to her table and maps. Going straight ahead is where Julie stands, just outside the indoor Brahmin pen. Next to Josie there is a set of stairs that leads up to part of the overlook of the tunnel. Between Josie and Marley there is a short step into a long narrow hallway that leads to a door on the right to enter Ineke's office where she can be found sitting. There is a sign left of the door reading "Antiques" with an hand pointing to the door to also guide the Vault Dweller to her office. Following down the hallway past Ineke's office, there is a step down and a small balcony. Following the small balcony leads to Theodore's set up, where he has an inaccessible gate door behind him. Going to the step down brings the Vault Dweller back to the ground level between a small bar and kitchen area with no one in it and to Axel and Gyro's nook of the cavern that has outdoor light shining down on them.

To access the higher overlook level, the Vault Dweller can go up the stairs next to Josie, or follow the ramp up by Axel and Gyro. The part of the overlook near Axel and Gyro has a small sitting area filled with mounted taxidermy, displayed weapons, and some miscellaneous file cabinets and boxes. Attached to this is a narrow tunnel that leads to the overlook of where Josie stands. The floor of this section is also the roof of the Brahmin pen. There is nothing on this section of the level except for a few shelves with some boxes and lamps.

Milepost Zero appears in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Milepost Zero* update.
